source.publication: 2025 MI-1040 Forms and Instructions (includes Form 4884 instructions)
source.section: Schedule 1 line 28 and its worksheet lines 1-8 (PDF page 17: born prior to 1946, maximum 14,688 single); PDF page 3 General Information; MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 20,000.00 + interest 6,000.00 + dividends 3,000.00 + long-term gains 1,000.00 + taxable Social Security 13,850.00 (gross 30,000.00; provisional income 45,000.00: 0.85 x 11,000.00 + 4,500.00 = 13,850.00, under 85% of gross) = 43,850.00. Federal taxable income = 43,850.00 - federal standard deduction (15,750 + 1 x 2,000 age 65 or older = 17,750.00) = 26,100.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan (born 1944): Schedule 1 line 14 Social Security 13,850.00. No retirement benefits, so line 27 0.00. Line 28 worksheet: line 1 14,688.00; lines 2-4 0.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 14,688.00; line 7 interest, dividends and gains 6,000.00 + 3,000.00 + 1,000.00 = 10,000.00; line 8 smaller 10,000.00 to Schedule 1 line 28. Wages stay taxed. Subtractions 23,850.00. Line 14 = 43,850.00 - 23,850.00 = 20,000.00; exemption 5,800.00; line 16 = 14,200.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 14,200.00 x 0.0425 = 603.50. No credits; state income tax 603.50.
